content: Elasticsearch zero-downtime reindex pattern: (1) Create new versioned index (my_index_v2) with updated mapping. (2) Reindex existing data from v1 to v2 using _reindex API (async with wait_for_completion=false for large datasets). (3) Dual-write to both indices during catch-up or use timestamp-based catch-up reindex. (4) Atomic alias swap: remove alias from v1, add to v2 in single _aliases API call. (5) Application always queries through alias, never concrete index names. For event-sourced systems: replay from event store into new index while live projection continues on old index; swap alias when caught up.
